Ingrid Novak
ingrid.novak@example.com | Richmond, VA
Ingrid Novak has 8 years of experience in backend and distributed systems. Most
recently, Senior Backend Engineer at Quartzline Cloud (2025-2026), where they
led migration of core services at Quartzline Cloud onto REST API design,
improving uptime during peak load. Before that, Backend Engineer at Quartzline
Infrastructure (2018-2025). Education: B.S. Electrical Engineering, University
of Cincinnati, 2017. Core skills: CI/CD, TypeScript, Distributed systems, REST
API design.
